rationale: Retain the predeclared default of four adjacent paired passes per block and 40 confirmatory pairs. The speed-level-blinded 24-pair pilot has paired-log-ratio autocorrelations 0.083, 0.011, 0.144, and 0.036 at lags one through four, without sustained positive dependence. The four-pair block lag-one value 0.323 is based on only six pilot blocks; the eight-pair estimates use only three and do not establish better independence. The measurement agent recommended eight-pair blocks as a conservative response to that persistence and differential half-run drift; the owner and independent blinded reviewer retained the default because doubling block length does not cure nonstationarity. Observed half-run relative duration changes were -0.024688148540579435 for original and -0.0070313826804246915 for replacement, with paired-log-ratio change -0.017481542895687582. The interval remains conditional on independent representative blocks. All files and samples are retained; no speed level, confidence interval, significance, or pilot absolute duration was inspected for this decision.
